opener: Father, I need to stop performing peace I don't actually have.
lines: I release what was never mine to fix — their silence, the excuses I keep rehearsing, the version of me that flinches before it's even hurt again.
Teach me the difference between forgiving someone and staying open to be wounded by them again.
Grow roots in me deep enough that I can be loved imperfectly and still not be moved by what they withhold.
Heal the part of me that keeps score, and give me courage to set the boundary love truly requires.
bold: I release what was never mine to fix
ctaLine: Save this. Share this. Someone you love needs to hear it too.
